finding: The check of RL-18-LN-01 misses a later read of the installed copy in any file that already holds the scope-lint link. installed_copy_reads looks back from each match with text.rfind("symlink_to("), so it finds the nearest earlier call anywhere in the file, not the call that encloses the match. A bare REPO_ROOT / ".agent-factory" after the link then counts as the link. The review ran the function on two lines, the link followed by 'installed = REPO_ROOT / ".agent-factory"': it returned []. The second line alone returned the read. test_core_layout_gates.py holds the link at line 484, so a read added below it passes. Count a match as the link only when its start lies inside the span of a SCOPE_LINT_LINK match, and add that two-line sample to test_RL_18_LN_01_a_read_of_the_installed_copy_counts.
why_this_severity: No test file holds such a read today, the check finds every other form, and the suite run in a linked worktree with no .agent-factory/ fails a real runtime read (no to fails_purpose). A read added below the link in test_core_layout_gates.py passes the text check, and the maintainer learns of it only from a red worktree run.
